# ElevenLabs Music Generation Skill for Muse

The official ElevenLabs skill for generating music from a text prompt via the ElevenLabs Music API (music_v2_5 model): instrumentals, songs with lyrics, background music, jingles. It supports prompt-based generation, composition plans (up to 30 blocks with per-section positive/negative styles for fine control), video-to-music (score a video), streaming, and inpainting (regenerate a time range of an existing track, upload/extend tracks). Documented for the Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, and CLI, with output formats and content restrictions (no artist references, no copyrighted lyrics). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: an API key is required; the free tier's credits are limited (streaming and heavy use mean paid plans); upload inpainting is enterprise-only. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
